subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox support Google Cloud Run sandboxes in public preview as a built-in provider, including the operator-deployed gateway and environment-secret contract?
rationale: The implementation is not merely a mechanical provider adapter: it adds a preview-service support commitment and a new remote execution security boundary that require repository product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor experimental support
options.body: Accept the provider as explicitly preview/experimental support after a rebase and focused review of the gateway and credential contract.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Keep the work unmerged until Cloud Run sandboxes or the required gateway contract has a clearer supported lifecycle and ownership model.

options.title: Narrow to a supported extension path
options.body: Ask for a smaller adapter or documented external integration if core should not own the gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor experimental support
recommendation.body: Accept the provider as explicitly preview/experimental support after a rebase and focused review of the gateway and credential contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest provider safety commits provide the strongest available evidence of ownership for this implementation direction.
